Based on your uploaded sources, here are the definitions, numbers, and page/section-level citations for each parameter:

---

### 1. Heating Degree Days (HDD) Definition

* **Swiss Standard (SIA 381/3 / "20/12" Convention)**:
  * **Base Temperature**: **\\(20.0^\circ\text{C}\\)**
  * **Heating Limit (\\(T_{\text{limit}}\\))**: **\\(12.0^\circ\text{C}\\)** (heating is triggered on days where the daily average outdoor temperature \\(T_{\text{avg}} < 12.0^\circ\text{C}\\)).
  * **Formula**: 
    \\[\text{HDD (Switzerland)} = \begin{cases} 20^\circ\text{C} - T_{\text{avg}} & \text{if } T_{\text{avg}} < 12^\circ\text{C} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}\\]
  * **Source Title & Section**: 
    * *2503.16993v1 (1).pdf* — Section 2.1.3 ("Weather Data"), Page 3, Formula (1).
    * *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks* — Section 5 ("SIA 2028: Climate & Design Parameters").

* **US Standard (provided in weather metadata for comparison)**:
  * **Base Temperature / Heating Limit**: **\\(18.3^\circ\text{C}\\)** (\\(\text{HDD} = \max(0, 18.3^\circ\text{C} - T_{\text{avg}})\\)).
  * **Source Title & Section**: *2503.16993v1 (1).pdf* — Section 2.1.3 ("Weather Data"), Page 3, Formula (2).

---

### 2. Design Outdoor Temperature (\\(T_{\text{design}}\\))

* **Zurich / Swiss Plateau**: **\\(-10.0^\circ\text{C}\\)** (per SIA 384.201 / SIA 2028).
  * **Source Title & Section**: 
    * *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks* — Section 1 ("SIA 384.201") & Section 5 ("SIA 2028").
    * *Heat Pump Control Configuration: Heating Curve, SG Ready & DHW Settings* — Section "Heating Curve Configuration", Paragraph "Practical Application".
* **Other Regional Values in Sources**:
  * **Vienna (Austria)**: **\\(-13^\circ\text{C}\\)** (per ÖNORM EN 12831).
  * **Munich (Germany)**: **\\(-12^\circ\text{C}\\)** (per DIN EN 12831).
  * **Source Title & Section**: *Heat Pump Control Configuration: Heating Curve, SG Ready & DHW Settings* — Section "Heating Curve Configuration", Paragraph "Practical Application".

---

### 3. Indoor Setpoint (\\(T_{\text{set}}\\))

* **Standard Indoor Setpoint**: **\\(20.0^\circ\text{C}\\)**
  * **Source Title & Section**: *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks* — Section 3 ("SIA 380/1 & SIA 2024: Target Values & Standard Usage Data").

---

### 4. Standard Air Change Rate (\\(n_{\text{air}}\\))

* **Natural Window Ventilation**: **\\(0.7\text{ h}^{-1}\\)**
* **Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR)**: **\\(0.4\text{ h}^{-1}\\)**
  * **Source Title & Section**: *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks* — Section 3 ("SIA 380/1 & SIA 2024: Target Values & Standard Usage Data").
